headline: Approved retirement benefits for Brian S. Ricard and Michael E. Whalen, and a lump sum death benefit of $145,046.32 for Patricia Grimes Patrician.
summary: The Board of Trustees approved the July 31, 2026 minutes, three retirement and death benefit items, and discussed ongoing attorney review of ordinance wording and IRS updates. Trustees also discussed redaction practices for public documents. The next meeting was scheduled for September 25, 2026.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 31, 2026 meeting.
Approved the retirement benefit to Brian S. Ricard with a Contingent Annuitant benefit of $3,128.12/mo.
Approved the retirement benefit to Michael E. Whalen with a Contingent Annuitant benefit of $3,586.36/mo.
Approved a Lump Sum Death Benefit Distribution of $145,046.32, including the standard $3,000 death benefit, to Patricia Grimes Patrician as beneficiary of Andrew M. Patrician.

BOARD OF TRUSTEES 
Division of Public Works Retirement System 
Meeting Minutes 
August 28, 2026 
 
 
A meeting of the Board of Trustees, Public Wo rks Retirement System was held at 10:32 a.m. 
on Friday, August 28, 2026 in The Mine Falls Conference Room located at 848 West Hollis 
Street, Nashua, NH 03062.   
 
Trustees Present: 
 
David Fredette, Finance & Investment Professional (Chairman) 
Daniel Hudson, Unaffiliated Employee Member  
Matt Dube, AFSME Employee Member 
Terri Harris, UAW Employee Member 
 
Trustees Absent: 
 
Manny Espitia, BPW Commissioner 
Diane Mulholland, Treasurer/Tax Collector, Member 
Michael O’Brien, Aldermanic Liaison (Assistant Chair)  
 
Others in Attendance: 
 
 Dawn Enwright, City of Nashua CFO 
 Joanne Boisvert, Trust Accountant 
 Mary Woods, Administrative Assistant 
 
Expected Visitors: 
 
None 
 
Minutes of the Meeting: 
 
The minutes of the July 31, 2026 meeting were presented for review and acceptance.  
 
MOTION BY:  Trustee, Terri Harris moved to approve the minutes of the July 31, 2026 
meeting as reviewed and presented. 
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Matt Dube 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:   
 
 
Personnel: 
 
A. MOTION BY: Trustee, Matt Dube moved to approve the retirement benefit to Brian S. 
Ricard who has chosen a Contingent Annuitant benefit of $3,128.12/mo.  
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Terri Harris 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:
Page 2 of 2  
 
B. MOTION BY:  Trustee, Matt Dube moved to approve the retirement benefit to Michael E. 
Whalen who has chosen a Contingent Annuitant benefit of $3,586.36/mo.  
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Daniel Hudson 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:  
 
C. MOTION BY: Trustee, Matt Dube moved to approve the Lump Sum Death Benefit 
Distribution of $145,046.32 which includes the standard $3,000 death benefit to Patricia 
Grimes Patrician as the beneficiary of Andrew M. Patrician. 
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Terri Harris 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:  
 
 
Old Business: 
 
 Trustee Fredette is waiting for Attorney Clarke to get back to him on some wording changes 
to an Ordinance and also changes to a retirees Death Benefit amount to hopefully increase 
it.  He will report back when he gets a chance to speak with her. 
 
 Trustee Fredette also reported that regarding the update for IRS ordinance changes, he has 
not spoken to the attorney to see if there is any word from the IRS.  He has emailed the 
attorney but has not gotten a response. 
 
 
New Business:  
 
None 
 
Period for Public Comment: 
 
None 
 
 
Items by the Trustees: 
  
There was a discussion on redactions on Public Documents. Trustee Fredette expressed 
the retirement amounts approved are significant amounts and all the trustees need 
to review names and signatures to ensure rules are followed.   
 
 
Next meeting will be scheduled for Friday, September 25, 2026, at 10:30 a.m.  
 
MOTION TO ADJOURN:  Trustee, Daniel Hudson moved to adjourn at 10:52 a.m. 
SECONDED BY: Trustee, Matt Dube 
MOTION CARRIED:  Unanimously by the members in attendance 
DISCUSSION: 
 
Minutes Transcribed by:  Mary Woods
